## Problem

What were you trying to do, and where did the current workflow stop helping?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the action and visible result you want. An example project or screen helps.

## Limits or alternatives

List constraints that matter, such as provider cost, privacy, or saved-work compatibility. Mention a workaround if you use one.
